header.title: Spa Orlane Paris by Las Mañanitas Regulations
header.subtitle: Operating hours: From 08:00 to 20:00 hrs.
header.description: To enjoy a unique experience in our SPA, please take the following rules into account:

rules.1: All SPA treatments are unisex and are available for both hotel guests and external clients.
rules.2: Couples (man and woman) are not allowed to enter the hydrothermal circuit, as there are separate areas for men and women.
rules.3: A prior reservation is mandatory and subject to availability.
rules.5: SPA services for pregnant women are subject to conditions. (Consult your doctor).
rules.6: It is mandatory to complete a clinical form indicating your health conditions, which must be filled out before accessing any SPA service.
rules.7: It is the client's responsibility to inform the SPA reception of any important changes.
rules.8: In case of delay to the treatment by the client, the establishment may limit its duration based on other existing appointments.
rules.9: The SPA provides clients with a locker key, where they will find a basket for belongings, slippers, a towel, and hangers for clothing. The key must be returned to the SPA reception upon leaving the facilities.
rules.10: The materials used during treatments are for internal use only and must be returned to the SPA.
rules.11: Entry is prohibited for individuals in an improper condition.
rules.12: The consumption or introduction of food, alcoholic beverages, or other substances not provided by our establishments is prohibited.
rules.13: The SPA is not responsible, civilly or criminally, for damages suffered by the client as a result of improper use of the facilities/equipment or for loss, theft, and/or damage of personal belongings.
rules.14: We recommend our clients remove all jewelry before any treatment.
rules.15: One of the characteristics of the SPA is its calm, quiet, and serene atmosphere; therefore, we ask our clients to maintain a respectful attitude to ensure a proper environment.
rules.16: Bringing food and drinks into the pool area is prohibited.
rules.17: You must shower before using any facility.
rules.18: Use of the pool is at the user's own risk.
rules.19: Smoking inside the SPA facilities is strictly prohibited.
rules.20: For health reasons, no more than 15 minutes is recommended in the jacuzzi, steam room, and sauna.
rules.21: For health and safety reasons, treatments cannot be provided under the influence of alcohol or drugs.
rules.22: For your safety, walking barefoot inside the SPA facilities is not allowed.
rules.23: Wearing a swimsuit is mandatory in wet areas.
rules.24: Please do not use body products in the jacuzzi, steam room, sauna, or pool.
rules.25: Use of the jacuzzi, sauna, or steam room is strictly prohibited for individuals with contagious diseases or open wounds.
rules.26: The SPA manager has the authority to deny access to the facilities to individuals who do not comply with these regulations or who, in their judgment, may pose a risk.
rules.27: The use of speakers or any device to play music is not allowed.
rules.28: Use headphones or keep music volume very low in the pool area.

footer: Please leave your personal belongings in the safety box in your room and/or locker. Keep the key with you at all times. The SPA and the hotel are not responsible for forgotten or lost items.
If no discomfort is reported to the therapist during the session, it will be understood that everything was satisfactory and the full charge for your treatment will be applied.
The treatment/massage you received is strictly professional. Any inappropriate behavior will result in termination of the session and removal from the facilities with full charge applied.
Please leave your personal belongings in the safety box in your room and/or locker. Keep the key with you at all times. The SPA and the hotel are not responsible for forgotten or lost items.

palacio_cortes.name: Palacio de Cortés
palacio_cortes.description: A historic monument commissioned by Hernán Cortés during the years following the Conquest of Mexico, built on the remains of the ceremonial and tribute center dedicated to Tláhuac known as Tlatlocayacalli. It is currently the Cuauhnáhuac Regional Museum.

catedral_cuernavaca.name: Cuernavaca Cathedral
catedral_cuernavaca.description: A 16th-century building, making it one of the oldest cathedrals in the country and the fifth Franciscan foundation in Mexico. It was established in 1525 by the first twelve Franciscan friars who arrived in the country, with the support of a newly arrived group from Spain.

jardin_borda.name: Jardín Borda
jardin_borda.description: A historic museum located in what was once the summer residence of wealthy miner José de la Borda from Taxco. Its beautiful gardens, baroque fountains, and wide walkways surrounded by lush trees create a unique setting. Within the garden, there is a lake with small boats, as well as a museum where handicrafts can be found.

museo_robert_brady.name: Robert Brady Museum
museo_robert_brady.description: Former residence of Robert Brady, an American collector who decorated his home with a collection of over 1,300 art pieces, including paintings, sculptures, prints, and handicrafts from around the world. Among the highlights are works by Rufino Tamayo, Frida Kahlo, Diego Rivera, María Izquierdo, Miguel Covarrubias, and many others.

tour_tepoztlan.name: Tepoztlán Tour
tour_tepoztlan.description:
5-hour visit and tour of the town of Tepoztlán. It is considered one of the 15 most beautiful places in the country, known for its mystical atmosphere, legends, and traditions still preserved by its inhabitants. Its spectacular mountains will captivate you.

Hike up Tepozteco Hill to visit the pyramid dedicated to Ometochtli Tepoztecátl, the god of pulque, where you can enjoy a breathtaking panoramic view. After descending, the tour continues to the Ex-Convent of the Nativity, built by the indigenous people of Tepoztlán and known for its beautiful geometric decorations on ceilings and corridors. The tour includes a visit to the artisan market and concludes at a restaurant where you can enjoy traditional Mexican cuisine.

tour_xochicalco.name: Xochicalco Tour
tour_xochicalco.description:
4–6 hour visit and tour of the archaeological site. Xochicalco is located in the municipality of Miacatlán in the state of Morelos, Mexico. It was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1999.

The archaeological zone includes the main plaza, which houses a shrine and the Great Pyramid; La Malinche, where 20 circular altars are located; the palace; and the southern ball court. The main plaza is the most important space in this sacred city, as it features the Pyramid of the Feathered Serpent. There is also a museum with a collection of archaeological objects discovered in the area, including ceramics and sculptures.

tour_taxco.name: Taxco City Tour
tour_taxco.description:
4–6 hour visit and tour. The tour begins with a visit to a silver workshop, where you will receive an introduction to the different processes used to work silver, inside a simulated mine.

Afterward, we visit the beautiful Parish of Santa Prisca, built in the 16th century, a remarkable example of New Spanish Baroque art. You will have free time to explore and enjoy this colonial city, starting at the main square, continuing through artisan areas and silver museums.

For lunch, you will have time to visit a traditional restaurant in Taxco.

tour_grutas.name: Cacahuamilpa Caves
tour_grutas.description:
4–6 hour visit and tour of the caves. These majestic caves are located in the Sierra Madre del Sur, spanning parts of the states of Guerrero and Morelos.

Inside, the caves contain an enormous variety of fascinating rock formations that spark the imagination of visitors. The site also features underground rivers that can be explored if desired. More than 90 chambers are open to the public and can be toured in approximately 2 hours. The walk, about 2 kilometers long, is highly rewarding, with guides sharing details and stories that enrich the experience.

tour_casaresiu.name: Casa Resiú Nayaá Tour
tour_casaresiu.description:
The largest mezcal distillery in Mexico. Experience a tour designed to explore the origin and production process of the finest artisanal mezcal.

Agave piñas are ground using a stone tahona, and the extracted nectar is fermented in wooden vats and double distilled in copper stills, all under the care of master mezcal artisans.

• 2-hour guided tour through agave fields.
• Guided visit of the distillery.
• Mexican snacks.
• Special tasting of up to 4 varieties: Aromas de Guerrero, Weber, Cupreata, and Criollo.
• 100% cacao chocolate tasting.
• Bottle of Criollo mezcal (50 ml).

cuernavaca.title: CUERNAVACA, MORELOS
cuernavaca.subtitle: BETWEEN HISTORY AND GARDENS
cuernavaca.itinerary:
1.- Begin the day with breakfast at Las Mañanitas, surrounded by lush gardens and a tranquil atmosphere that distinguishes this emblematic hotel. Our restaurant offers the ideal setting to start the day with a gastronomic proposal inspired by the flavors of Morelos.

2.- Just a few minutes away is the Regional Museum of the Peoples of Morelos (Palacio de Cortés), one of the most representative historic buildings in the country. Walk through its halls and discover centuries of history through archaeological collections, viceregal art and the iconic murals by Diego Rivera.

Fact of interest: This construction, built in the 16th century, is considered one of the oldest colonial civil works in Mexico.

3.- Continue to Jardín Borda, a haven of serenity that once served as a rest residence for Emperor Maximilian and Empress Carlota. Its gardens, fountains and paths invite a leisurely stroll. If you wish to complement the cultural experience, the Robert Brady Museum houses an extraordinary collection of international art in a 16th-century mansion.

4.- For lunch, we suggest Casa Hidalgo, a restaurant with a privileged terrace overlooking the Historic Center. While enjoying a contemporary Mexican cuisine proposal, you can contemplate the Cathedral and the Regional Museum of the Peoples of Morelos, in an atmosphere that combines history, gastronomy and architecture.

5.- Before returning to Las Mañanitas, take a break at Carpe Diem Gelato, where you will find artisan gelatos made with seasonal ingredients. A fresh and elegant way to conclude your tour of the City of Eternal Spring.

tlaltizapan.title: TLALTIZAPÁN, MORELOS
tlaltizapan.subtitle: THE HEART OF ZAPATISMO
tlaltizapan.itinerary:
1.- After enjoying breakfast at Las Mañanitas, set out on the journey to Tlaltizapán, considered one of the most important settings of the Zapatista movement and a fundamental piece of Morelos history.

2.- The first stop is the Zapatista Barracks Museum, former operations center of the Liberating Army of the South. Its halls preserve documents, photographs and original objects that allow visitors to understand the legacy of Emiliano Zapata.

Fact of interest: From this place, some of the most important strategies of the revolutionary movement in the south of the country were coordinated.

3.- A few steps away you will find the Mausoleum of Emiliano Zapata, a site of deep historical significance where the memory of the Caudillo del Sur and those who participated in the agrarian struggle is honored.

4.- For lunch, we recommend El Fuerte de San Miguel, a restaurant recognized for rescuing traditional Morelos cuisine in a tranquil setting. Among its specialties are clemole, rabbit in adobo and ash tamales, prepared with traditional recipes from the region.

5.- Before returning, walk through the streets of Tlaltizapán, whose architecture preserves the essence of the early 20th century. A walk that allows you to appreciate the historical legacy of one of the most representative municipalities of Zapatismo.

cuautla.title: CUAUTLA, MORELOS
cuautla.subtitle: SCENES OF THE REVOLUTION
cuautla.itinerary:
1.- Begin the day with breakfast at Las Mañanitas before heading to Cuautla, a city that played a leading role in some of the most important events of the Mexican Revolution.

2.- Start the tour at the Old Railway Station, where the historic meeting between Francisco I. Madero and Emiliano Zapata took place. Today, this space preserves part of the railway and revolutionary memory of the state.

Fact of interest: Cuautla was the scene of the historic Siege of Cuautla, one of the most relevant episodes of the revolutionary struggle in Mexico.

3.- Continue to the Plaza Revolución del Sur, a place that allows you to understand the strategic importance the city had during the Zapatista movement.

4.- For lunch, we suggest Casa de la Abuela, recognized for its regional cuisine and traditional atmosphere. Do not miss the longaniza de Cuautla, one of the most emblematic gastronomic products of the municipality, accompanied by handmade tortillas and traditional salsas.

5.- Conclude the tour at the Zócalo de Cuautla, where the Municipal Palace, gardens and historic monuments offer an excellent closing to discover the cultural legacy of this city.

zempoala.title: LAGUNAS DE ZEMPOALA
zempoala.subtitle: FORESTS AND HIGH MOUNTAIN LANDSCAPES
zempoala.itinerary:
1.- Begin the day with breakfast at Las Mañanitas before heading to Lagunas de Zempoala National Park, one of the most impressive natural landscapes in central Mexico.

2.- Upon arrival, enjoy a boat or horseback ride while contemplating the pine and oak forests surrounding the lakes.

Fact of interest: The park is part of an important biological corridor and is home to a great diversity of flora and fauna characteristic of high mountain ecosystems.

3.- Walk its natural trails to discover endemic species and enjoy the tranquility offered by this protected environment. If you wish, you can use nature observation apps to identify some of the species present in the park.

4.- For lunch, we recommend the Los Colorines restaurant in Huitzilac, recognized for its traditional mountain cuisine. Do not miss the wild mushroom broth, huitlacoche quesadillas and authentic café de olla, prepared with ingredients from the region.

5.- Before concluding the visit, explore the areas near the lakes where the mountain axolotl (Ambystoma altamirani) lives, one of the most representative and valuable species of this ecosystem. Conclude the experience by returning to Las Mañanitas, where the tranquility of its gardens will be the perfect complement for a day in contact with nature.

nature.subtitle: Forests, rivers, mountains and landscapes that invite you to discover the natural wealth of Morelos.

barranca.title: BARRANCA DE CHAPULTEPEC, CUERNAVACA, MORELOS
barranca.subtitle: A NATURAL BREATH IN THE HEART OF CUERNAVACA
barranca.itinerary:
1.- After enjoying breakfast at Las Mañanitas, take a short trip to Barranca de Chapultepec, one of Cuernavaca's most emblematic natural spaces. Its trails, bridges and bodies of water offer an ideal setting to walk calmly and enjoy the natural wealth guarded by this urban oasis.

Fact of interest: The ravine is the habitat of the Barranqueño crayfish, an endemic species of Morelos that can only be found in some bodies of water in the state.

2.- During your visit, take a break at Tovari Café, a cozy space surrounded by vegetation where you can enjoy specialty coffee, artisanal pastries or a light breakfast while contemplating the natural landscape of the park.

3.- Continue exploring the less traveled trails of the ravine. Along the way you will find small corners where the sound of water and vegetation create an atmosphere of absolute tranquility, perfect for contemplating the surroundings and preserving a memory of your visit.

4.- Upon finishing the tour, return to Las Mañanitas and allow the experience to continue among our gardens. Our concierge team will be delighted to assist you with recommendations to complement your stay.

5.- To conclude the day, enjoy dinner at Las Mañanitas restaurant, where haute cuisine, personalized service and the natural setting create the perfect backdrop for ending a day dedicated to rest and connection with nature.

zempoala_huitzilac.title: LAGUNAS DE ZEMPOALA, HUITZILAC, MORELOS
zempoala_huitzilac.subtitle: BETWEEN FORESTS, LAKES AND MOUNTAIN AIR
zempoala_huitzilac.itinerary:
1.- Begin the day with breakfast at Las Mañanitas, where the tranquility of our gardens and a carefully crafted gastronomic proposal will be the perfect start before heading to one of the most representative national parks in Mexico.

2.- Before arriving at Lagunas de Zempoala, we suggest making a brief stop in Tres Marías, recognized for its culinary tradition. Enjoy freshly made quesadillas accompanied by café de olla or artisanal hot chocolate, an experience that is part of the gastronomic identity of the region.

3.- Continue the journey to Lagunas de Zempoala National Park, where pine and oak forests surround a landscape of lakes, trails and natural viewpoints. You can explore the park on horseback, walk the trails or simply contemplate one of the most impressive natural settings in Morelos.

Fact of interest: This park is part of an important biological corridor connecting the ecosystems of Morelos and the Valley of Mexico, harboring a great diversity of high mountain flora and fauna.

4.- For lunch, we recommend Los Colorines in Huitzilac, a restaurant recognized for rescuing the traditional cuisine of the region. Do not miss the wild mushroom broth, huitlacoche quesadillas and authentic café de olla, prepared with local ingredients.

5.- Back at Las Mañanitas, enjoy an afternoon of relaxation in our gardens or let our concierge team recommend an experience to complement your stay. As night falls, dinner at our restaurant will be the perfect close to a day among mountains and nature.

manantiales.title: BALNEARIO LOS MANANTIALES, COAXITLÁN, MORELOS
manantiales.subtitle: A DAY DEDICATED TO REST AND NATURE
manantiales.itinerary:
1.- After breakfast at Las Mañanitas, make your way to Balneario Los Manantiales, a destination recognized for its crystal-clear waters and natural surroundings, ideal for a relaxing day.

Fact of interest: The springs that feed this resort maintain a pleasant temperature throughout the year, allowing guests to enjoy its pools and waterfalls in any season.

2.- Walk its trails, discover its natural waterfalls and let the tranquility of the landscape accompany you throughout the experience. It is a destination designed for disconnecting from daily life and fully enjoying the surroundings.

3.- For lunch, we suggest visiting Restaurante El Encanto, where you can enjoy traditional Morelos cuisine made with fresh regional ingredients. Among its specialties are green mole with pumpkin seeds, cecina and various typical dishes prepared to order.

4.- Upon finishing the visit, return to Las Mañanitas for an afternoon of rest. Our restaurant and gardens offer the ideal atmosphere to conclude the day with a gastronomic experience that combines hospitality, nature and haute cuisine.

texcal.title: PARQUE ESTATAL EL TEXCAL, JIUTEPEC, MORELOS
texcal.subtitle: NATURE, GEOLOGY AND ADVENTURE
texcal.itinerary:
1.- Begin the morning with breakfast at Las Mañanitas before discovering one of the most important natural reserves in the state of Morelos.

2.- Parque Estatal El Texcal preserves landscapes formed by ancient volcanic processes, vegetation-lined trails and natural viewpoints that allow visitors to appreciate the ecological richness of the region. You can walk or cycle its paths while discovering an environment completely different from the city.

Fact of interest: The name "Texcal" comes from Nahuatl and refers to the volcanic rock formations that characterize this natural reserve.

3.- After the tour, we recommend enjoying lunch at Casa Taxco Cuauhnáhuac, a restaurant recognized for its contemporary Mexican cuisine. Do not miss the green mole, huazontle or any of its specialties made with seasonal ingredients.

4.- Upon returning to Las Mañanitas, let the tranquility of our gardens mark the end of the day. If you wish, our concierge team can recommend additional activities to enjoy an unforgettable stay.

hongos_azules.title: BOSQUE DE LOS HONGOS AZULES, SANTA MARÍA AHUACATITLÁN
hongos_azules.subtitle: AN ENCOUNTER WITH THE BIODIVERSITY OF MORELOS
hongos_azules.itinerary:
1.- Begin the day with breakfast at Las Mañanitas before heading to Santa María Ahuacatitlán, a region recognized for its forests and extraordinary natural wealth.

2.- Walk the interpretive trails of the Bosque de los Hongos Azules, where you will discover the ecological importance of this unique species and the role it plays in the balance of forest ecosystems.

Fact of interest: Fungi contribute to the natural cycle of the forest by decomposing organic matter and promoting soil regeneration. Some species can only thrive in perfectly preserved ecosystems.

3.- During the visit you can enjoy horseback rides, boat tours and rest areas that allow you to appreciate the tranquility of the surroundings. Be sure to visit the Orchid Garden, a space dedicated to the conservation of various species of orchids and native plants.

4.- For lunch, we recommend the forest restaurant, recognized for using regional ingredients in its preparations. Do not miss the traditional mushroom broth, one of the most representative dishes of this area of Morelos.

5.- Conclude the experience by returning to Las Mañanitas, where the serenity of our gardens and personalized service will allow you to end a day dedicated to discovering nature. If you wish, dinner at our restaurant will be the ideal complement to close the day with the gastronomic excellence that distinguishes our hotel.

adventure.subtitle: Experiences for those who want to explore Morelos from a perspective full of excitement and extraordinary landscapes.

tepoztlan.title: TEPOZTLÁN, MORELOS
tepoztlan.subtitle: BETWEEN MOUNTAINS, ADVENTURE AND TRADITION
tepoztlan.itinerary:
1.- Begin the day with breakfast at Las Mañanitas, where the tranquility of our gardens and gastronomic excellence create the ideal atmosphere before discovering one of the most emblematic Magical Towns in Mexico. We recommend wearing comfortable clothing and appropriate footwear to fully enjoy the experience.

2.- Upon arriving in Tepoztlán, take a brief break at one of the terraces in the historic center, such as Casa Grande, where you can enjoy a coffee or light breakfast with a privileged view of the mountains surrounding the valley.

3.- Continue to the natural trails leading to Cascada Los Venaditos, a corner surrounded by vegetation that takes on special beauty during the rainy season. If you prefer a panoramic hike, the trails offer extraordinary views of the mountainous landscape that distinguishes this region.

Fact of interest: Tepoztlán is located within a protected natural area and its rock formations are millions of years old, making it one of the most representative geological landscapes in central Mexico.

4.- The adventure continues in San Juan Tlacotenco, where you can discover caves and natural formations that reveal a little-known facet of Tepoztlán. This tour allows you to appreciate the geological richness of the municipality while enjoying a nature-surrounded environment.

5.- For lunch, we suggest Axitla Restaurante, recognized for rescuing traditional Morelos cuisine in a natural and welcoming setting. Do not miss the traditional itacates, made with native corn and filled with regional ingredients, as well as other specialties prepared with seasonal products.

6.- Before returning, enjoy a panoramic drive through the roads surrounding the valley. The mountain landscapes and vegetation make the journey part of the experience.

7.- To conclude the day, return to Las Mañanitas and let the experience continue among our gardens. Dinner at our restaurant will be the perfect complement to close a day dedicated to nature, tradition and the gastronomy of Morelos.

Las Mañanitas Recommendation: Our concierge team will be delighted to assist you with reservations, private transportation or personalized recommendations so you can make the most of your visit.

las_estacas.title: LAS ESTACAS, MORELOS
las_estacas.subtitle: BETWEEN SPRINGS AND CRYSTAL-CLEAR WATERS
las_estacas.itinerary:
1.- Begin the day with breakfast at Las Mañanitas, surrounded by tropical gardens and an atmosphere of absolute tranquility. Then, set out on the journey to Las Estacas, one of the most extraordinary natural parks in Morelos.

2.- Upon arrival, walk the trails bordering the river and discover the transparency of its waters, fed by a natural spring that maintains a pleasant temperature throughout the year.

3.- The first recommended experience is snorkeling, an activity that allows you to admire fish, aquatic plants and natural formations while exploring one of the most crystal-clear rivers in the state.

Fact of interest: The spring that gives rise to the river produces thousands of liters of water per minute, making it one of the main natural tributaries in the region.

4.- Continue with one of the interpretive tours organized by the park, where you will learn about the history of the place, the importance of its ecosystems and the species that inhabit this natural reserve.

5.- For lunch, we recommend El Fuerte de San Diego, recognized for its traditional Mexican cuisine and nature-surrounded atmosphere. Among its specialties are Morelos-style cecina, armored tacos and various recipes made with fresh regional ingredients.

6.- In the afternoon, enjoy a paddle experience to explore the river from a different perspective. The tranquility of the water and the beauty of the surroundings make this activity one of the most memorable moments of the tour.

7.- Upon finishing the visit, return to Las Mañanitas, where you can relax in our gardens or enjoy dinner prepared with the gastronomic quality that distinguishes our hotel.

Las Mañanitas Recommendation: We suggest bringing a swimsuit, biodegradable sunscreen and comfortable clothing to fully enjoy this experience in contact with nature.

tlayacapan.title: TLAYACAPAN, MORELOS
tlayacapan.subtitle: BETWEEN HISTORY, NATURE AND TRADITION
tlayacapan.itinerary:
1.- After enjoying breakfast at Las Mañanitas, set out on the journey to Tlayacapan, one of the Magical Towns with the greatest cultural and historical richness in Morelos, recognized for preserving its traditional architecture and ancient customs.

2.- Upon arriving at the historic center, enjoy a traditional breakfast at Emilianos Restaurante, where you can taste the emblematic gorditas de haba or requesón, made following recipes passed down through generations.

3.- Continue with a hike to Cerro de la Tonantzin, from where you can admire spectacular panoramic views of the valley and walk trails surrounded by vegetation characteristic of this region.

Fact of interest: Tlayacapan was one of the first municipalities in Morelos to receive the Magical Town designation, thanks to the preservation of its historical, architectural and cultural heritage.

4.- Depending on the season, you can visit the Pozas Azules, located between Tlayacapan and Amatlán. During the rainy season they offer an exceptional landscape; outside of season, we suggest walking the streets of the town, discovering its artisan workshops and admiring its historic buildings.

5.- For lunch, we recommend La Renacuaja, a restaurant recognized for rescuing the traditional flavors of Morelos. Do not miss the ash tamales, one of the most representative gastronomic specialties of the region.

6.- In the afternoon, visit the El Tlatoani Archaeological Zone. The tour begins along natural trails leading to ancient vestiges and petroglyphs, allowing visitors to discover one of the least known and most fascinating archaeological zones in the state.

7.- Before returning to Las Mañanitas, enjoy the last landscapes of Tlayacapan. Back at the hotel, our gardens and restaurant will offer the perfect atmosphere to conclude a day full of history, nature and tradition.

Las Mañanitas Recommendation: If you would like an even more comfortable experience, our concierge team can assist you with personalized recommendations and the organization of your tour.

tequesquitengo.title: TEQUESQUITENGO, MORELOS
tequesquitengo.subtitle: BETWEEN THE LAKE, ADVENTURE AND UNFORGETTABLE LANDSCAPES
tequesquitengo.itinerary:
1.- Begin the day with breakfast at Las Mañanitas, where our gardens and the restaurant's gastronomic proposal create the ideal atmosphere before discovering one of the most emblematic destinations in Morelos. Then, set out on the journey to Tequesquitengo, recognized for its lake and for offering some of the most exclusive adventure experiences in the state.

2.- Upon arrival, enjoy a light breakfast or coffee at La Cabaña, a restaurant with a privileged view of the lake. Its terrace is the perfect place to contemplate the landscape while preparing for the day's activities.

3.- The first experience begins from the heights. If you wish to live an unforgettable adventure, skydiving will allow you to contemplate the lake and its surroundings from a unique perspective. For those who prefer a calmer activity, paragliding offers the opportunity to soar over the landscape with absolute freedom and enjoy an incomparable panoramic view.

Fact of interest: Thanks to its climate conditions and the extent of its lake, Tequesquitengo is considered one of the most important destinations in Mexico for aerial and water sports.

4.- The experience continues on the water with activities such as water skiing or jet skiing, ideal for exploring the lake while enjoying the speed and spectacular landscapes surrounding this destination.

5.- For lunch, we recommend La Cabaña Restaurante, one of the most recognized establishments in Tequesquitengo for its excellent location and regional cuisine. Do not miss the traditional mojarra al mojo de ajo, as well as garlic shrimp, fresh ceviches or fish prepared in the regional style, always accompanied by an extraordinary view of the lake.

6.- In the afternoon, if you wish to continue with the adventure, you can experience the thrill of bungee jumping, an experience that combines adrenaline with one of the best views of Tequesquitengo. If you prefer a more relaxed activity, a jet ski will allow you to explore the lake at your own pace and discover new corners of the landscape.

7.- Before returning, contemplate the sunset over the lake, a natural spectacle where golden tones reflect on the water and create one of the most memorable landscapes in Morelos. Back at Las Mañanitas, enjoy dinner at our restaurant and let the hospitality that distinguishes the hotel be the perfect close to a day full of excitement and unforgettable landscapes.

Las Mañanitas Recommendation: Our concierge team will be delighted to assist you with reservations for adventure activities and personalized recommendations so you can enjoy Tequesquitengo with total comfort and safety.

amacuzac.title: AMACUZAC, MORELOS
amacuzac.subtitle: BETWEEN RIVERS, WATERFALLS AND NATURE
amacuzac.itinerary:
1.- Begin the day with breakfast at Las Mañanitas, where the serenity of our gardens and gastronomic excellence offer the ideal start before discovering one of the most surprising natural regions in southern Morelos.

2.- Upon arriving in Amacuzac, the experience begins by navigating the river on a kayak or during a boat ride. While exploring its crystal-clear waters, you can admire tropical vegetation, observe various bird species and enjoy an environment that invites you to completely disconnect from everyday life.

Fact of interest: The Amacuzac River is part of one of the most important hydrological basins in central Mexico and, since pre-Hispanic times, has been an essential source for the development of communities in the region.

3.- Continue the tour exploring its natural trails. Ecotourism routes allow you to discover extraordinary biodiversity and offer excellent opportunities for flora and fauna observation, as well as contemplating some of the most representative landscapes in southern Morelos.

4.- For lunch, we suggest El Faro de Amacuzac, a restaurant recognized for rescuing traditional Morelos cuisine. Do not miss the chito, made with goat meat, accompanied by handmade tortillas, artisanal salsas and other dishes prepared with fresh regional ingredients.

5.- In the afternoon, visit the viewpoints and waterfalls that distinguish this destination. The tranquility of the surroundings, the sound of water and the panoramic views make this tour an ideal experience for enjoying nature and admiring some of the most authentic landscapes of Morelos.

6.- Before setting out on the return journey, let the last landscapes of Amacuzac be the crowning jewel of a day dedicated to ecotourism and adventure. Back at Las Mañanitas, you can relax in our gardens or enjoy dinner where contemporary Mexican cuisine and personalized service will perfectly complement your experience.

Las Mañanitas Recommendation: If you would like a more comfortable experience, our concierge team can assist you with tour organization, additional recommendations and private transportation services so you can enjoy every moment with complete peace of mind.
